title: Mealy Output Derived from next_state — Combinational Glitch
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [GLITCH] fsm_out pulsed for <1 clk period on input_sig transition; downstream sampled glitch
rtl: assign fsm_out = (next_state == ACTIVE);  // Derived from next_state — glitches on input transitions
expected_root_cause: fsm_out is assigned combinationally from next_state, which is itself a combinational function of state and input_sig; any glitch on input_sig propagates immediately to fsm_out as a sub-cycle pulse before the clock edge resolves it.
description: The fsm_out signal is combinationally assigned from next_state rather than state; since next_state is a combinational function of state and inputs, fsm_out can glitch for a fraction of a cycle when inputs change between clock edges.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [GLITCH] fsm_out pulsed for <1 clk period on input_sig transition; downstream sampled glitch
success_log: fsm_out registered — stable, glitch-free. Only transitions on posedge clk.
